releaseNotes: AURA 3.9.3 is a focused Kick measurement beta. Percussive hit peak is reserved for clipping and headroom safety, while program RMS drives the balance anchor. Continuous and Full Track averaging now includes time between percussive hits, preserving density. A hot but sub-zero Kick transient no longer freezes unrelated tonal-stem recommendations. Percussive REF rows show program RMS, its target, and hit peak for direct verification.
